# @stackline/update-section

Install: `npm install @stackline/update-section`
Drop-in alias: `npm install update-section@npm:@stackline/update-section`
Current release: `{{PACKAGE_VERSION}}`
Repository: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-update-section
Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/update-section/

Compatibility-first continuation of `update-section@0.3.3`. The callable
CommonJS API and enumerable `.parse` property are preserved. Corrections make
`endIdx` consistently inclusive, make `hasEnd` reflect a real match, ignore
end markers before the selected start, and support large replacement sections.
The package has no runtime dependencies. Node 12-24, TypeScript 3.9 and current,
ESM facade, and browser bundlers are supported.
